translations.text: You too are among them, called in Jesus Christ.
And I pray that now, by God's will, a way may be opened for me to come to you.
I want you to know, my brothers, that I have often wanted to come to you, but have been prevented until now, so that I might have fruit among you too, as among the other nations.

Likewise, their males also abandoned natural relations with females and burned with desire for one another. Males committed shameful acts with males and received in themselves the penalty that their error deserved.
And an instructor of those who lack understanding, a teacher of children, and you have in the law the pattern of knowledge and truth.
And the person who is naturally uncircumcised but fulfills the law will judge you, who transgress the law despite having the written law and circumcision.
For a person is not a Jew merely outwardly, nor is circumcision what is visible in the flesh.
But if our wrongdoing establishes God's righteousness, what shall we say? Is God unjust when he brings his wrath? I am speaking in human terms.
And they have not known the way of peace.
And the gift is not like the offense of one person. For the judgment that came from one person led to condemnation, but the gift, following many sins, led to justification.
For if we have been planted together with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be so in his resurrection.
For when you were slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.
The wages of sin are death, but God's gift is eternal life in our Lord Jesus Christ.
And I found that the commandment meant for life brought death.
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am of the flesh and am sold to sin.
Those whom he marked out beforehand, he also called; those whom he called, he also justified; and those whom he justified, he also glorified.
For in the place where they were called 'Not my people,' there they will be called children of the living God.
And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, 'How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news of peace and those who bring good news of good things!'
And it was said to him in a revelation, 'Look, I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not knelt on their knees or worshiped Baal.'
But I am speaking to you Gentiles. As an apostle to the Gentiles, I honor my ministry.
And perhaps you will say, 'The branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in their places.'
Likewise, these too have now been disobedient to the mercy shown to you, so that they too may receive mercy.
And who first gave to him and then received repayment from him?
For everything is from him, everything is in him, and everything is through his hand. To him be praises and blessings forever and ever. Amen.
And do not conform to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your minds, so that you may discern what God's will is: good, acceptable, and perfect.
Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil with good.
For what he said—“Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” and “Do not covet”—and any other commandment is fulfilled in this saying: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
And may I come to you with joy, by the will of God, and find rest with you.
Greet Amplias, my beloved in our Lord.
Now to God, who is able to strengthen you through my gospel, which was proclaimed about Jesus Christ, through the revelation of the mystery that had been hidden for ages:
But it has now been revealed through the writings of the prophets, and by the command of the eternal God it has been made known to all nations for the obedience of faith.
